title: Prairie Sun solar construction status
brief: Prairie Sun Energy is building a 40 MW solar farm, and the construction manager, Ingrid Valdez, needs a status page for the lenders and the owner as of 2026-10-16. Overall status is red. Headlines: 60480 of 96000 panels installed, 63.0 percent; 14 of 20 inverters installed; 41.5 million dollars budget with 27.8 million spent (67.0 percent). Panels installed per week over the last four weeks: 3300, 3050, 3200, 3150, an average of 3175. To finish all panels by 2026-12-04, 7 weeks away, the crew has to average 5074 a week, so at the current pace panels would be finished about 2027-01-02. Under "Milestones": Site grading, done 2026-05-22; Foundations and trackers, done 2026-09-04; Panels installed, planned 2026-12-04, forecast 2027-01-02; Substation witness test, 2026-11-19; Energization, 2027-01-15, at risk; Commercial operation, 2027-02-01. Under "Needs attention": a second crew starting 2026-10-26 would add about 2200 panels a week, taking the rate to about 5375 a week, enough only if no more than 2 weather days are lost; the owner must approve 380000 dollars for the second crew by 2026-10-21. Sections: "Project at a glance", "Installation pace", "Milestones" and "Needs attention".

edit.request: Update panels installed to 63840, which is 66.5 percent, and move the second crew approval deadline to 2026-10-23.
